Become a member, follow the instructions to join the Discord, and verify your membership on tyt.com/call. See you on the air! 🎙️
Hear from one of our members how AWESOME Member Mondays is! At TYT, we do the show WITH our audience! Find out how to participate and talk to Cenk yourself at tyt.com/call! 📞
